note: Ten CTCAE v5.0 terms used as AEDECOD for Interim's PRO-CTCAE-modeled items. The grade text is reference/hover text only: Interim's provisional grade comes from participant answers via the composite table (CLAUDE.md 3.4b) and grades 4-5 are never assigned.
grade_null_note: null = NCI prints '-' for that grade (not defined for this term).
meddra_code_note: meddra_code is the code as printed in the NCI CTCAE v5.0 workbook, kept for reference; Interim ships no MedDRA dictionary and does not validate these codes. The runtime rules table packages/rules/data/ctcae_terms.json carries a clearly labeled meddra_code_mock for AE drafting; this file is the reference view (GET /reference/ctcae). Label the printed codes 'as printed in CTCAE v5.0' in the UI.

grades.1: Shortness of breath with moderate exertion
grades.2: Shortness of breath with minimal exertion; limiting instrumental ADL
grades.3: Shortness of breath at rest; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an uncomfortable sensation of difficulty breathing.

grades.2: Moderate symptoms, medical intervention indicated; limiting instrumental ADL
grades.3: Severe symptoms; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by sudden, often repetitive, spasmodic contraction of the thoracic cavity, resulting in violent release of air from the lungs and usually accompanied by a distinctive sound.

terms.meddra_soc: General disorders and administration site conditions

grades.2: Fatigue not relieved by rest; limiting instrumental ADL
grades.3: Fatigue not relieved by rest, limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a state of generalized weakness with a pronounced inability to summon sufficient energy to accomplish daily activities.

grades.1: Loss of appetite without alteration in eating habits
grades.2: Oral intake decreased without significant weight loss, dehydration or malnutrition
grades.3: Inadequate oral caloric or fluid intake; tube feeding, TPN, or hospitalization indicated

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a queasy sensation and/or the urge to vomit.

grades.1: Increase of <4 stools per day over baseline; mild increase in ostomy output compared to baseline
grades.2: Increase of 4 - 6 stools per day over baseline; moderate increase in ostomy output compared to baseline; limiting instrumental ADL
grades.3: Increase of >=7 stools per day over baseline; hospitalization indicated; severe increase in ostomy output compared to baseline; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an increase in frequency and/or loose or watery bowel movements.

grades.1: Macules/papules covering <10% BSA with or without symptoms (e.g., pruritus, burning, tightness)
grades.2: Macules/papules covering 10 - 30% BSA with or without symptoms (e.g., pruritus, burning, tightness); limiting instrumental ADL; rash covering > 30% BSA with or without mild symptoms
grades.3: Macules/papules covering >30% BSA with moderate or severe symptoms; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by the presence of macules (flat) and papules (elevated). Also known as morbillform rash, it is one of the most common cutaneous adverse events, frequently affecting the upper trunk, spreading centripetally and associated with pruritis.

grades.1: Mild or localized; topical intervention indicated
grades.2: Widespread and intermittent; skin changes from scratching (e.g., edema, papulation, excoriations, lichenification, oozing/crusts); oral intervention indicated; limiting instrumental ADL
grades.3: Widespread and constant; limiting self care ADL or sleep; systemic corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy indicated

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an intense itching sensation.

grades.3: Severe pain; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a sensation of marked discomfort in a joint.

terms.meddra_soc: General disorders and administration site conditions

grades.3: >40.0 degrees C (>104.0 degrees F) for <=24 hrs
grades.4: >40.0 degrees C (>104.0 degrees F) for >24 hrs

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by elevation of the body's temperature above the upper limit of normal.

grades.1: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated
grades.2: Moderate pain or ulcer that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated
grades.3: Severe pain; interfering with oral intake

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by ulceration or inflammation of the oral mucosal.
